name: Downtown Disney Jazz Kitchen Coastal Grill & Patio: Classic Café du Monde-Style Beignets & Plain Grilled Fish/Chicken
brandOrRestaurant: Jazz Kitchen Coastal Grill & Patio / Beignets Expressed (Downtown Disney District)
whyItWorks: At the table-service patio, you can request plain grilled Gulf fish or chicken breast with steamed white rice (no Cajun blackening), and at the walk-up **Beignets Expressed** window you can share classic warm New Orleans powdered-sugar beignets.
prepOrOrderInstructions: For dinner, ask for Grilled Fish or Chicken with **NO Cajun spice** and steamed white rice (avoid the spicy Pasta Jambalaya and dark Gumbo); at Beignets Expressed, stick to classic Powdered Sugar Beignets.
watchOuts: Avoid Pasta Jambalaya (spicy Andouille sausage + cayenne) and glazed beignets with citrus/berry seeds
